evidence.quote: Laboratory records do not include complete data derived from all tests, examinations, and assay necessary to assure compliance with established specifications and standards.
Electronic records are used, but they do not meet audit trail requirements to ensure that they are trustworthy, reliable and generally equivalent to paper records.

evidence.quote: Your firm’s complaint investigations are inadequate in that to date no root cause(s) have been identified to assure product quality and patient safety.
Your Audit Trail Review procedure and practice is inadequate.
